cards.title: Structural Awareness
cards.editorial_question: What has to stay attached to a decision when its context travels?

editorial_readings.label: Structural Awareness
editorial_readings.reading: The research programme examines what can be known, decided and controlled under partial representations.

editorial_readings.label: The Given Universe Axiom
editorial_readings.reading: The axiom frames limits on recovering distinctions that are missing from available records.

editorial_readings.label: Ecosystem Awareness
editorial_readings.reading: Qualify evidence, dependencies, provenance and limits for a defined decision.

editorial_readings.label: Regime Awareness
editorial_readings.reading: Detect conditions that could invalidate an earlier interpretation or operating assumption.

cards.title: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss
cards.editorial_question: What happens when the portfolio counts assets but misses their operators?

editorial_readings.label: Attribution Gap
editorial_readings.reading: The capacity that sustains a result and the capacity credited for it can differ.

editorial_readings.label: Contribution evidence
editorial_readings.reading: Identify the technical or operational contribution of a capability.

editorial_readings.label: Architecture decision
editorial_readings.reading: Change or preserve dependencies, applications and controls using evidence of capability and use.

editorial_readings.label: Organisational attribution
editorial_readings.reading: Decision-makers assign recognition and credit for capability.

cards.title: The Map and The Flow
cards.editorial_question: Where can a representation diverge from the operation it coordinates?

editorial_readings.label: The Map and the Flow
editorial_readings.reading: The published essay examines what can be lost when a representation of work replaces the flow through which value is produced.

editorial_readings.label: Loss from a divergent operational map
editorial_readings.reading: A control can cause loss when its representation omits the flow that matters.

editorial_readings.label: Informational Friction and Cost of Clarity
editorial_readings.reading: Information movement and producing decision-ready clarity consume work in different ways.

editorial_readings.label: Process observability
editorial_readings.reading: Reconstruct work, events and dependencies from observable evidence.
